messages:
Brianna Cole: Quick ask: we need a 1-page customer-facing 'tech probe' to send to three renewal-risk accounts. It should be fillable by their engs and include: 1) a short checklist for caching/batching/streaming, 2) three one-line validation commands they can run, and 3) a tiny telemetry anchor list AMs can request. Aim: under 1 page and ready to paste into email.

Ethan Morris: Love the name 'tech probe'. Keep the form fields minimal. For thresholds, I suggest: cache_hit < 30% -> optimization candidate; p95 > 500ms -> ops review; error_rate > 1% -> escalate. Also include a recommended immediate change per failure (e.g., enable prefix cache, lower batch_size).

Vera Liu: Add a short "self-test harness" paragraph pointing to a tiny repo snippet (node/python) so they can reproduce locally. For streaming guidance: enable streaming for responses that typically take >300ms; for UI flows use batch_size 1-4.

cs_toolbot: Tip: use `/fetch-metrics <acct>` to auto-populate cache_hit, p95, and error_rate into the form.

Noah Kim: I'll draft the quick one-page. Pasteable customer checklist below (one-line items so AMs can paste into email):
---
TECH PROBE: CUSTOMER FILL (please complete prior to call)
- Account name:
- Eng contact (name / email):
- Affected endpoint(s):
- Cache approach (prefix / response / shared KV):
- Cache TTLs observed (s):
- Cache hit % (7d):
- batch_size (min / max):
- streaming enabled? (y / n):
- p95 latency (24h):
- error rate (24h):
- Recent config changes (14d):
- Top 3 user flows to test:
---

Noah Kim: Three runnable checks to paste for their engs:
1) Streaming quick smoke:
```
curl -s -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Prefer: streaming=1" -d '{"input":"probe","stream":true}' https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate
```
2) Simple latency loop (Linux):
```
for i in {1..12}; do time curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"ping"}' https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate; done
```
3) Cache header check:
```
curl -I -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate | grep -i cache
```

Vera Liu: Telemetry anchors for AMs to request (one-line each): cache_hit_rate (7d), p95 latency (24h), error_rate (24h), request_volume (1h), recent config changes. Include a one-line action mapping:
- Cache_hit low -> advise prefix caching + increase TTL -> schedule 30m tuning
- p95 high -> run batch/concurrency audit -> ops deep-dive
- Error rate high -> open SRE ticket + throttling review

Ethan Morris: Also add an immediate quick-fix cheat sheet (checkboxes) for customers:
- Increase cache_ttl to 1800-3600s for stable prompts
- Move repetitive prompts to prefix caching
- Reduce batch_size to 1-4 for interactive UI flows
- Enable streaming for generation >300ms
- If traffic is bursty, enable warm-pools/autoscale burst rather than large batches

Brianna Cole: This is exactly what we need. Noah 1 please produce: 1) a one-page PDF, 2) plain-text email snippet, 3) a tiny link to a repo with node/python smoke tests. Tag me when done and I'll route to AMs.

cs_toolbot: Created task CS-TECHPROBE-301 assigned to Noah Kim.

Noah Kim: Will post draft here in ~2h.
